verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Hightouch serves an llms.txt at hightouch.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an 'Agent API' section, so an agent can be pointed at it. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec is also published and powers the rendered API reference, which supplements the agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt contents beyond its header and 'Agent API' heading, markdown versions of the docs (docs.md returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json
the reference is generated from the published OpenAPI document
